cues.text: Traditional smart contracts can calculate balances, but they cannot judge wit. Welcome to RoastWars, the world's first autonomous comedy arena powered by GenLayer.
By running LLMs directly inside validator consensus, RoastWars brings subjective intelligence and comedic judgment fully on-chain.
In the arena lobby, contenders create or match one on one duels, staking native GEN tokens in a zero-gas escrow pot.
Whether trading vicious burns or wholesome compliments, both punchlines are securely locked into the contract.
When a duel closes, five independent validator nodes deliberate, scoring each line from zero to ten based on comedic timing and delivery.
In this example battle, Alice scores nine out of ten to claim victory, instantly unlocking the double prize pot directly to her wallet.
Every punchline, score, and payout is recorded immutably on-chain. Contenders climb the Hall of Fame to claim supremacy as the sharpest comedian on Web3.
Experience the future of intelligent contracts today. Connect and battle live at roastwar dot vercel dot app.
